verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine and runtime. It streams MoE expert weights from SSD, serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and ships on-device apps. It has no automation or workflow layer, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is outside its product category. Swapping adapter files is model-artifact management, not automation versioning, and does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
